headline: Over 5,000 locations. One signature.
concept: The FCC's Broadband Serviceable Location Fabric rendered literally as cloth. The weave stops mid-bolt, warp hanging into the dark. One shuttle rests on the tear line, loaded and motionless, because a loom advances only when it is thrown. That is 47 U.S.C. 1702.

eval_history.fix: soft_panel left a visible smudge halo; weave read as corduroy stripes; 196px shuttle read as a FISH
true plain-weave checkerboard killed the stripes but went mechanical, and the headline quiet zone left a HARD-EDGED rectangle
smooth elliptical calm + per-thread slub + twill drift fixed the cloth; shuttle's oval cavity still read as an eye
rebuilt as a real loom shuttle (flat bottom, rectangular pirn well, steel tips); still gold-on-gold, no value gap
seated the shuttle over the void and darkened body to bronze; added a drawn torn edge. Cleared the 8.5 floor
8.5 is the floor not the target: drape folds added meso structure to the upper ~45% of flat cloth acreage

eval_final.note: Crashes (numpy 2.x ndarray.ptp removal; missing circle import) were fixed and re-run and do not count as eval iterations, per the skill.
